picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge team's AI-guided vaccine design achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in trials, demonstrating AI's potential to accelerate defenses against pandemic-threat pathogens.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: MIT's $53 million ARPA-H award to use generative AI for discovering safer herbicide alternatives is a major federal investment pairing AI discovery tools with pressing agricultural and environmental needs.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena—from sand to proteins—in a single AI system, a notable step toward general-purpose scientific simulation.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, signals a coordinated national push to embed agentic AI tooling across the government's scientific research infrastructure.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Germany is backing TUM's new autonomous public transportation center with up to 20 million euros in federal funding, a significant bet on AI-driven mobility infrastructure.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI research—spanning physical AI, agentic AI, and robotics—reflects Europe's push for industrial AI independence.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics firm Unitree, building toward a joint lab, marks a significant academia-industry alliance advancing embodied AI and robotics research and training.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's funding for ANU to modernize fusion simulation tools with AI shows industry capital accelerating progress toward practical fusion energy.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: MIT and Carnegie Mellon researchers' new 'Workspace Models' memory approach lets robots recall past observations cheaply, addressing a key bottleneck in robot learning.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely synthetic self-generated data, a finding with broad implications for reducing AI's dependence on real-world data.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It
